rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a glass building where delicate plants are cultivated.

example.english: There are lots of orchids in this conservatory.
example.traditional: 呢間溫室入面種咗好多蘭花。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 wan1 sat1 jap6 min6 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 laan4 faa1

rows.note: Use this for a school where people learn music, rather than for a plant-growing building.

example.english: I studied piano at a conservatory when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣喺音樂學校學過鋼琴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hai2 jam1 ngok6 hok6 haau6 hok6 gwo3 gong3 kam4
